channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Gabriel Deck | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Gabriel Deck from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jose Calderon on Facundo Campazzo, Gabriel Deck
item.description:
“Then it depends on the role, the physicality, the rhythm... NBA is not easy. Some players like Gaby Deck or Facundo Campazzo may not fit here for different reasons, but they can have amazing careers in Europe,”

Jose Calderon on Facundo Campazzo, Gabriel Deck, Dec 11, 2022. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Sam Presti on Gabriel Deck
item.description:
Sam Presti on Gabriel Deck:

“We’ve liked Gabi for awhile. Argentinians... have a spirit to the way they play... an inherent toughness. He’s so driven to prove himself in the NBA.I thought he did quite well in the 10 games he played. I’m a fan. I think he’s a winning player.”

Sam Presti on Gabriel Deck, May 20, 2021. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Luguentz Dort on Gabriel Deck
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Lu Dort on Gabriel Deck’s debut tonight:

“I’m really excited for him to be here with us. I’m looking forward to playing with him.”

Luguentz Dort on Gabriel Deck, Apr 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Gabriel Deck
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Daigneault on Gabriel Deck:

“Not sure on the timetable. But we’re excited about the player. We can’t wait to get him in the fold. He can help us this year and moving forward. Our scouting department has watched him for years and knows him intimately. He has all the intangibles.”

Mark Daigneault on Gabriel Deck, Apr 13, 2021. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.
